'''Elmar Schrüfer''' (23 May 1931 – 22. May 2022)<ref name="KDGK96">{{cite web |title=Kürschners Deutscher Gelehrten-Kalender 1996 : Bio-bibliographisches Verzeichnis deutschsprachiger Wissenschaftler der Gegenwart (page 1267)) |url=https://archive.org/details/kurschnersdeutsc0000unse/page/1266/mode/2up?q=Elmar%20Schr%C3%BCfer%20festschrift%20messen%20pr%C3%BCfen |publisher=Berlin : De Gruyter |access-date=9 May 2025 |date=1996}}</ref><ref>[https://trauer.sueddeutsche.de/traueranzeige/elmar-schruefer Traueranzeige Elmar Schrüfer] auf ''trauer.sueddeutsche.de'' vom 28. Mai 2022</ref> was a [[Germans|German]] [[physicist]] and [[professor]] for measurement technology. He was known for his contributions to university education in electrical measurement technology, the related fields of reliability of measurement and automation equipment and [[signal processing]],<ref name="Koch">{{cite web |last1=Koch |first1=Alexander |title=In memoriam Schruefer |url=https://www.ee.cit.tum.de/fileadmin/w00cfk/mst/_my_direct_uploads/220621_Text_WWW_MST_awk_ME-in-memoriam_Schruefer.pdf |access-date=7 May 2025}}</ref> as well as radiation and its measurement in [[nuclear power plants]].<ref name="KDGK96" /> The 13th edition of his university textbook "''Elektrische Messtechnik : Messung elektrischer und nichtelektrischer Größen''" (Electrical measurement technology: Measurement of electrical and non-electrical quantities) was published in 2022.<ref>{{cite book |last1=Schrüfer |first1=Elmar |last2=Reindl |first2=Leonhard M. |last3=Zagar |first3=Bernhard |title=Elektrische Messtechnik: Messung elektrischer und nichtelektrischer Größen |url=https://d-nb.info/1262415365 |publisher=Hanser |access-date=9 May 2025 |date=2022|isbn=978-3-446-47164-1 }}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Elmar Schrüfer was born in Edelbach in Spessart in 1931<ref name="KDGK96" /> as the eldest of four children. His father was a teacher. Schrüfer attended the [[Gymnasium (school)|Gymnasium]] in [[Aschaffenburg]] until 1950, then studied [[physics]] at the [[Julius-Maximilians-Universität Würzburg]]. He was awarded his [[doctorate]] in 1958 with a thesis on the energy distribution in the spectrum of the [[X-ray]] [[bremsstrahlung]] of a 35 [[MeV]] [[betatron]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Schrüfer |first1=Elmar |title=Energieverteilung im Spektrum der Röntgenbremsstrahlung eines 35 MeV Betatrons |url=https://d-nb.info/480819335 |access-date=9 May 2025 |date=1958}}</ref>

== Industrial activities ==
After completing his PhD, he began working in industry, first at ''[[AEG (German company)|Allgemeine Elektricitätsgesellschaft]]'' (AEG), and later at ''[[Kraftwerk Union]]'' (KWU).<ref name="KDGK96" /> His work included radiation measurement technology on research and power [[nuclear reactor|reactors]], and he eventually published the book ''Strahlung und Strahlungsmesstechnik in Kernkraftwerken'' (Radiation and Radiation Measurement Technology in Nuclear Power Plants), which guided the activities of the ''[[Technischer Überwachungsverein]]e'' (TÜV).{{citation needed|date=May 2025}}

He was later responsible for the design, procurement, installation and commissioning of the entire instrumentation (nuclear and conventional, measurement, and signal processing) of [[nuclear power plants]]. One focus of his work was the [[nuclear safety and security|safety]] of the plants. By the time he left Kraftwerkunion, Schrüfer had been promoted to a department head.<ref name="KDGK96" />

== Research and teaching ==
While still working in industry, Schrüfer received a teaching assignment from the [[University of Karlsruhe]] in the field of ''reactor instrumentation''. Schrüfer was appointed in 1975<ref name="KDGK96" /> as a [[professor]] of electrical measurement technology at the [[Technical University of Munich]], and remained in this position until his retirement in 1998. Even after his retirement, he remained active in student exchange activities.<ref name="CDHK">{{cite web |title=On The Death Of Prof. Dr. Elmar Schrüfer, The First Specialist Coordinator For The Faculty Of Electrical Engineering At The CDHK |url=https://cdhk.tongji.edu.cn/cdhkDE/09/2a/c26864a264490/page.htm |website=cdhk.tongji.edu.cn |access-date=7 May 2025}}</ref> Journalist Katarina Bader remarked in 2006:
:As soon as one enters the office of Prof. Elmar Schrüfer in the "Technische Universität München" (TUM) one knows: this is not only the working place of a very well respected expert on Metrology but also room of a cosmopolitan in the very best sense of word: Prof. Schrüfer is obviously interested in all kinds of cultures and it is evident that he has friends all over the world. On the walls there are pictures from Kiev, Beijing and Petersburg and on the top of the cupboard there is hardly any free space due to all these beautiful handmade [[Matryoshka doll|matroshkas]], Chinese vases and framed little pictures which are standing up there very accurately lined up.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Bader |first1=Katarina |title=Schrüfers Liste |url=https://www.schruefer-messtechnik.de/Stipendienprogr__Ost/Schrufers_Liste/schrufers_liste.htm |website=www.schruefer-messtechnik.de |access-date=7 May 2025}}</ref>

Cooperation with foreign universities, especially those in [[Eastern Europe]] and [[China]], was a particular concern of Schrüfer. In this, he was supported by his wife, Anna.{{citation needed|date=May 2025}} Early on, he made efforts to establish contact with colleagues in the [[German Democratic Republic|GDR]].{{citation needed|date=May 2025}}

Schrüfer was a Consult. Prof. at both [[Huazhong University of Science and Technology]] in 1983 and [[Northwestern Polytechnical University]] in 1993, and he was a guest professor at [[Peking University]] in 1993.<ref name="KDGK96" />

Together with Professors [[Hans-Rolf Tränkler]] (Universität der Bundeswehr München) and [[Friedrich Schneider (engineer)|Friedrich Schneider]] (TUM), the ''Stipendienprogramm Ost'' (Scholarship Program East) was established. As part of this program, students from Eastern European universities were able to spend six months writing their theses in the laboratories of Munich universities. This program was not financed by the state, but by third-party funds. By 2004, more than 70 students had taken part in the program.{{citation needed|date=May 2025}}

Schrüfer was active in the [[Chinesisch-Deutsches Hochschulkolleg|Chinese-German University College]] (CDHK) at [[Tongji University]] in [[Shanghai]]. The CDHK, which specializes in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering and economics, which was run by the [[German Academic Exchange Service]] (DAAD), and was financed by both DAAD and German companies. Schrüfer helped plan and set up the electrical engineering branch of study and was its director until 2005. As part of this project, over 200 Chinese electrical engineering students came to TUM between 1998 and 2013, 150 of whom obtained a double [[master's degree]] from Tongji University Shanghai and TUM.{{citation needed|date=May 2025}}

In addition to teaching and research, Schrüfer made numerous contributions within and outside the university. From 1989 to 1991, he was [[Dean (education)|Dean]] of the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Information Technology. He was a member of the Faculty Council for many years and a reviewer for the [[German Research Foundation]], the [[Alexander von Humboldt Foundation]] and the [[Volkswagen Foundation]].{{citation needed|date=May 2025}} In 1986 on the occasion of an honorary colloquium on the 70th birthday of [[Theodor Gast]], Professor of [[Metrology]] at the [[TU Berlin]], the idea was born to found a "Working Group of University Professors of Metrology" (AHMT) was founded. Schrüfer was the first chairman,<ref name="Koch" /> and remained in the post until 1991. The annual conferences of the AHMT became an essential part of scientific communication in the field of colleges and universities as well as the metrology industry.{{citation needed|date=May 2025}}

== Awards and honors ==
* 1991 [[Festschrift]] for the 60th birthday of Prof. E. Schrüfer (Messen & Prüfen Volume 10, 1991)<ref>{{cite web |title=Messen & prüfen: m & p; Fachmagazin für angewandte Meß- u. Prüftechnik |url=https://d-nb.info/012604550 |website=Catalogue of the German National Library |publisher=IVA Internat |access-date=9 May 2025 |date=1964}}</ref>
* 1992 [[Honorary doctorate]] from the [[Kyiv Polytechnic Institute]]<ref name="KDGK96" />
* 1993 [[Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany]] (Cross of Merit)<ref name="KDGK96" /><ref name="Koch" />
* 1998 Karl Max von Bauernfeind Medal of the [[Technical University of Munich]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Karl Max von Bauernfeind-Medaille - TUM |url=https://www.tum.de/ueber-die-tum/daten-und-fakten/auszeichnungen-und-ehrungen/auszeichnungen-der-universitaet/karl-max-von-bauernfeind-medaille |website=www.tum.de |access-date=7 May 2025}}</ref>
* 2000 [[Honorary doctorate]] from the [[Gheorghe Asachi Technical University of Iași]]<ref name="Koch" />
* 2004 Honorary doctorate from the [[National Aviation University]] in [[Kyiv]]<ref name="Koch" />
* 2013 Honorary Senator of the Chinese-German University College (CDHK) at Tongji University Shanghai.<ref name="Koch" />
